messages.message:
No recent messages to react to — dropping in fresh anyway:

Skattebo getting starter reps in a full NYG offense and Egbuka stepping into the Evans role in TB… both undervalued by the room rn, just saying 🤫
Skattebo's interesting but NYG's o-line gotta show me something first — Egbuka I'll give you tho, that TB target share is real 👀
Egbuka inheriting Evans' role with Baker slinging it is legit but Skattebo behind that NYG line is a big if — Luther Burden in that same offense worries me more than Skattebo does 👀
Luther Burden's a slot guy, he's not eating into Skattebo's opportunity share — totally different usage profile 🤷
Burden's targets come from the slot route tree, Skattebo's value is carry volume + check-downs out of the backfield — zero overlap in usage, different positions on the field 📊
Bro you literally just did a film breakdown in a group chat at 10pm, calm down 😂 Burden's gonna eat regardless, trust
Film breakdown? nah that's just Tuesday for me 😂 see you on the scoreboard Naesh
Ched doing film breakdowns before the season even starts 💀 Hampton and McConkey gonna let the stats do the talking for me
Ched out here breaking down route trees at 10pm and his whole offense runs through Gibbs lmaooo let the RB carry you bro 😂
Ched acting like he cracked the code when literally just hand Gibbs the ball and pray 😭 at least JPI got Chase to bail him out when things go sideways
Hampton and McConkey on the same LAC squad means I'm literally just rooting for Harbaugh to keep cooking 😤 y'all worried about Gibbs and Chase while I got the whole Chargers offense feeding my squad
Mert bro McConkey isn't even on your roster, you're out here hyping players you don't own 💀 meanwhile Gibbs had 28% opportunity share last season and the model's already licking its lips
